scope: Independent source-backed adjudication of combined Prism findings. No runtime changes, GUI, Git, Prism rerun or canonical mutation. Original reviewer regressions preserved.

findings.rationale: The sole nonnil publication constructs m.Cells with len(g.projection.Cells) and iterates that projection one-to-one (grid_geometry.go:88,94-99,108). currentMeasurement rejects mismatched generation, stamp, viewport and requested geometry (118-129). Geometry-changing portable transitions advance an exhaustion-checked monotonic generation; repeated snapshots of the same generation retain cardinality/order. Projection write is owner/origin refresh, measurement capture is origin scene serialization, and AX construction is owner-held. Public InspectGrid copies Cells/Headers (160-162), so callers cannot mutate internal lengths. No source-supported path publishes differing slices at a matching state; an extra bounds guard would mask unsupported private corruption.

The original reviewer regression intentionally permits safe refusal before allocation as an alternative to nonaliasing admission, matching the authorized reserved-prefix resolution. Its pre-fix native alias failure is preserved and original exact body rerun unchanged. Dedicated TestDataGridGeneratedNamespaceReserved in ui/grid_test.go exercises four grid: prefix shapes through nested modal descriptors and verifies ordinary ID grid remains allowed; TestDataGridDescriptor verifies a valid g descriptor. A weaker namespace guard allowing generated IDs fails the dedicated cases; overbroad rejection of the checked ordinary IDs fails positive controls. ui.Validate intentionally returns formatted errors without a namespace sentinel, so errors.Is on a nonexistent specific error would require an unrelated API change.

Application.Do synchronously acquires the owner mutex and invokes fn() directly in the calling goroutine (app/app.go:240-265). It neither posts nor starts an owner goroutine. The cited model tests invoke Do from the test goroutine, so t.Fatal/t.Fatalf terminates and fails that same test; Do deferred unlocking and abnormal-return Close also run. withModelOwner is an error-result convenience with identical execution, not a different goroutine boundary. The hypothetical worker-executed callback premise is false for these callsites.

Do result assignment could overwrite the separately produced State error in affected tests. One isolated test-only correction separates stateErr and verifies it after inline Do; source/runtime/consumer bytes remain unchanged. Independent source and proof review approves the targeted race3/vet qualification.

limits: No repeated live observation or broad new native audit; current final source/test ledger remains parent-owned.
Initial 50-file Prism input map covers pre-correction test; targeted independently reviewed test override must be explicit in final ledger.
